ruleset.source_game: Final Fantasy XIV (Manderville Gold Saucer, released patch 4.5, 2019-01-07)

target_score_oka_uma.note: No oka/uma in-game; ranked placement only affects external rating points, not in-game score

suits.pin_dots: 1-9 (stylized as Namazu in the Doman tile set)
suits.sou_bamboo: 1-9 (stylized as Sabotender/daggers in the Doman tile set)

tile_set.terminals: the 1 and 9 of each number suit

wall_layout.note: 13x4 = 52 dealt + dealer's first draw 1 + 70 live + 14 dead = 136; dead wall replenished to 14 after each kan replacement draw

dora.kan_dora: one additional indicator revealed per kan
dora.ura_dora: revealed only for a riichi winner; count equals the number of dora indicators
dora.ffxiv_display_quirk: By default the on-screen 'dora' area shows the ACTUAL dora tile, not the indicator (e.g. shown 2-man = dora is 2-man). A 'Traditional' setting (added patch 5.4) shows the previous-tile indicator instead.

hand_flow.turn_order: counterclockwise (the player to the right goes next)
hand_flow.turn: draw 1 tile, then discard 1 (the drawn tile may itself be discarded = tsumogiri)
hand_flow.win_check: on own draw (tsumo) or on an opponent's discard (ron)

chi.from: the player immediately to your left (whose discard precedes your turn)

ankan_closed.note: drawn 4th tile added to a concealed triplet

shouminkan_added.note: add the drawn 4th tile to an existing pon; can be robbed via chankan

kan.after_kan: reveal new dora indicator, then draw a replacement tile from the dead wall
kan.ffxiv_visual_quirk: all kans (even concealed ankan) are displayed in shouminkan form

kuikae.note: cannot claim a tile then discard an identical one, nor claim a tile merely to swap a meld

kuitan_open_tanyao.default: enabled in Novice Mahjong, Advanced Mahjong, and 4-player (Kuitan enabled)
kuitan_open_tanyao.disabled_room: only the 4-player (Kuitan disabled) Duty Finder option turns it off

atozuke.note: yaku are determined only at the moment of declaring the win

riichi.post_riichi: may only discard the tile drawn each turn; may pass/ignore a winning tile but is then placed in (permanent) furiten
riichi.closed_kan_after_riichi: permitted only if it does not change the waits

furiten.discard_furiten: any winning tile is in your own discards (incl. tiles others claimed via chi/pon/kan); ron disabled, tsumo still allowed; cleared by shifting the wait
furiten.temporary_furiten: passed a ron chance while not in riichi; cleared automatically after your next discard
furiten.riichi_furiten: passed a ron chance while in riichi; permanent for the rest of the hand

dealer_rotation.rotation_direction: passes to the next player (to the right) after each hand
dealer_rotation.renchan_dealer_repeat: dealer keeps the seat AND seat winds do not rotate if the dealer WINS or is TENPAI at an exhaustive draw; honba +1

honba.ron_payment: discarder pays an extra 300 per honba
honba.tsumo_payment: an extra 100 per honba from each of the other three players
honba.incremented_on: dealer win, exhaustive draw, or abortive draw

riichi_sticks.carry_over: if a hand ends in a draw, sticks remain on the table for the next winner
riichi_sticks.end_of_game: leftover riichi bets go to the 1st-place player

implemented: Nine terminals/honors in starting hand (kyuushu kyuuhai)
Four kans called by 2+ different players (suukaikan)
Same wind discarded by all four players on the first go-around (suufon renda)
not_implemented: Four riichi (suucha riichi) — there is NO abortive draw for four riichi in FFXIV
abortive_draws.effect: hand repeated, no points exchanged, honba +1, seat winds do not rotate
abortive_draws.kyuushu_condition: only valid if no chi/pon/kan/ankan has been called; a pair of terminal/honor counts as one type
abortive_draws.suukaikan_note: no abort if all four kans are by one player (they pursue the Four Kan yaku); a 5th kan then aborts

double_ron.note: if the dealer is one of the two ron winners, the hand is replayed with the same dealer/seat winds

pao_sekinin_barai.rule: the player who discards the completing 3rd dragon triplet / 4th wind triplet must pay the full yakuman; if the hand is won by ron, that player and the discarder split the cost 50/50

time_limits.warning_80_min: if a single hand lasts more than 80 minutes the following hand is the last; results are still recorded
time_limits.hard_cap_120_min: game ends automatically after 120 minutes; results NOT recorded

winning_a_hand.ron: complete the hand on a tile discarded by an opponent (discarder pays in full)
winning_a_hand.tsumo: complete the hand on a self-drawn tile
winning_a_hand.yaku_requirement: the hand MUST contain at least one yaku (dora/akadora/uradora alone never qualify); enforced at the win declaration under the atozuke rule

valid_winning_hand_shapes.chiitoitsu: 7 distinct pairs (closed only); a 4-of-a-kind does NOT count as two pairs
valid_winning_hand_shapes.kokushi_musou: one of each of the 13 terminal/honor types + one duplicate (closed only)

exhaustive_draw_ryuukyoku.trigger: live wall exhausted with no winner

payments.1_tenpai: tenpai player receives 1000 from each of the other three (3000 total)
payments.2_tenpai: each tenpai player receives 1500; each noten player pays 1500
payments.3_tenpai: each tenpai player receives 1000; the single noten player pays 3000

exhaustive_draw_ryuukyoku.dealer: keeps seat / seat winds frozen if dealer is tenpai; honba +1 either way

ends_on_South_4_if: the dealer is in 1st place and wins
the dealer is in 1st place and tenpai at the draw
game_end.agariyame: in the final hand, a 1st-place dealer who wins or is tenpai ends the game with no option to continue

tobi_bankruptcy.ends_immediately_if: any player's score drops BELOW zero

final_placement.tie_break: seat order relative to the dealer in the FIRST hand of the East round; closer to that dealer ranks higher (first dealer wins ties, then 2nd, then 3rd dealer)

scoring_and_formulas.model: FULL han + fu standard riichi scoring (NOT a flat per-han table). The community 'flat scoring' claim is a documentation error; 1000/2000/3900/8000 are simply the standard 30-fu non-dealer-ron column.
scoring_and_formulas.source_confirmation: riichi.wiki: 'Doman Mahjong uses the same rules as regular Japanese mahjong.'

fu_calculation.rounding: sum all fu, then round UP to the next multiple of 10 (except chiitoitsu, which is fixed at 25)

win_method_fu.open_pinfu_ron_exception: an open hand that would otherwise total 20 fu is set to 30 fu

meld_fu.rule: triplet base = 2 fu; x2 if terminal/honor; x2 if concealed; a kan = x4 of the corresponding triplet

pair_fu.note: pair of any dragon / round wind / seat wind = 2 fu; a double-wind pair (round AND seat) = 2 or 4 fu depending on ruleset (undocumented for FFXIV); non-yakuhai pair = 0

scoring_and_formulas.base_points_formula: base = fu * 2^(2 + han); base is capped at 2000 (= mangan) when no named limit applies

payment_multipliers.non_dealer_tsumo: base * 2 from the dealer + base * 1 from each of the two non-dealers
payment_multipliers.dealer_tsumo: base * 2 from each of the three players
payment_multipliers.rounding: each individual payment rounded UP to the nearest 100

scoring_and_formulas.dealer_bonus_note: A dealer win equals 1.5x a non-dealer win of the same han/fu, which falls naturally out of the 6x-vs-4x ron and 2x-all tsumo multipliers.
scoring_and_formulas.fu_skip_rule: If a hand reaches 5+ han it is a named limit hand and fu is no longer used.

triggers: 13+ counted han (kazoe yakuman, ENABLED in FFXIV)

limit_hands.tsumo_splits_for_limits: e.g. non-dealer mangan tsumo = 2000 from each non-dealer + 4000 from dealer; dealer mangan tsumo = 4000 from all three

dora_types.akadora_red_five: +1 han each (3 in game, one per suit); not a yaku; a red 5 that is also dora = +2 han
dora_types.uradora: +1 han each; only for riichi winners; not a yaku

worked_examples_proving_fu.note: 5200 and 7700 cannot be produced by a flat per-han table, confirming the engine computes fu.

yaku_list.notes: Fields han_closed / han_open. han_open = null means the yaku is unavailable when the hand is open. Any triplet-based yaku also accepts kans. Verified against the FFXIV Lodestone yaku list and Advanced Rules pages.

one_han.desc: Declare a ready closed hand while betting 1000 points.
Self-draw win with a fully concealed hand.
Win within one go-around of declaring riichi, with no intervening calls.
Closed all-sequence hand, non-yakuhai pair, two-sided (ryanmen) wait; structure yields 0 fu.
Two identical sequences (same suit, same numbers).

one_han.ffxiv_divergence: Open is allowed only when kuitan is enabled (all ranked rooms + 4-player Kuitan-enabled); closed-only in the single 4-player Kuitan-disabled room.

one_han.desc: Triplet/kan of any dragon; +1 han per such triplet.
Triplet/kan of the round wind (East in the East round, South in the South round).
Triplet/kan of your seat wind; a double-wind (round+seat) triplet counts for both = 2 han.
Win on the replacement tile drawn after declaring a kan.
Ron on a tile an opponent adds to a pon to form a shouminkan (kokushi may NOT rob a closed kan).
Tsumo on the last live-wall tile.
Ron on the final discard of the hand.

two_han.desc: Declare riichi on your very first discard with no prior calls by anyone.
The same sequence in all three number suits.
Every meld and the pair contains a terminal or honor.
Only terminals and honors; implies toitoi or chiitoitsu (scored separately).
Two dragon triplets + a pair of the third dragon (the two dragon yakuhai add +2 more, totaling 4 han).
The same-numbered triplet in all three number suits.
Three concealed triplets/kans (the fourth meld may be open).
Seven DISTINCT pairs; fixed at 25 fu; identical pairs are not allowed.

three_han.desc: Two distinct iipeikou; does not stack with iipeikou or with chiitoitsu.
Every meld and the pair contains a terminal (no honors).
One number suit plus honors only.

special_four_han.desc: At an exhaustive draw, all your discards were terminals/honors and none were claimed by an opponent.
special_four_han.ffxiv_divergence: Counts as a DRAW, not a win — the hand is replayed; it does not count as a win for wind rotation, honba, or riichi-bet purposes; cannot be claimed if your hand is open.

six_han.desc: One number suit only, no honors.

yakuman.note: Exactly TWELVE yakuman are permitted in FFXIV (Renhou/Blessing of Man is NOT included). All worth yakuman value (13 han). Stack up to 4. Suuankou-tanki, junsei chuuren, and juusanmen kokushi are each counted as a SINGLE yakuman.

list.desc: Dealer wins on their initial 14-tile draw; voided if any call/ankan is made.
Non-dealer wins on their first draw; voided by any call/ankan before that draw.
One of each of the 13 terminal/honor tiles + one duplicate. Cannot rob a closed kan; the 13-sided wait is subject to furiten. Pure 13-sided form counts as a single yakuman.
Four concealed triplets; the pair-wait (tanki) form is included as a single yakuman.
Triplets of all three dragons. PAO applies.
Three wind triplets + a pair of the fourth wind. PAO does NOT apply.
Triplets of all four winds. PAO applies.
Only green tiles: 2,3,4,6,8 of bamboo + green dragon.
list.ffxiv_note: Can be completed WITHOUT possessing the green dragon (green dragon is allowed but not required).

list.desc: 1112345678999 + any one extra, all of one suit; any number suit qualifies; pure 9-sided form counts as a single yakuman.
Four kans (open or closed); calling does not reduce the value.

explicitly_excluded: Renhou (Blessing of Man) — NOT among the permitted yakuman.
